2608.12001.title: Remote Sensing and Machine Learning-Based Analysis of Land Use and Vegetation Change in Dhaka District, Bangladesh
2608.12001.paper_summary: Rapid urbanization in Dhaka District, Bangladesh has triggered substantial alterations in land use and environmental conditions, necessitating systematic monitoring for informed urban planning and ecological sustainability. This study employs remote sensing data and machine learning techniques to analyze spatiotemporal changes in land cover and vegetation dynamics between 2019 and 2024. High-resolution satellite imagery from Sentinel-2 MSI and Landsat 8 was utilized to classify land cover types and compute spectral indices including the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI), and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI). A supervised machine learning approach incorporating Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Random Forest classifiers was applied using labeled geospatial training points within Google Earth Engine. Accuracy assessments were conducted using confusion matrices and kappa statistics. Results indicate a 59.5% increase in urban built-up areas and a significant decline in vegetation (-8.46%) and water bodies (-7.77%) over the five-year period. Land conversion from vegetated and aquatic areas to urban infrastructure was identified as a dominant trend. Among the models, Random Forest demonstrated the highest classification accuracy. These findings underscore the growing environmental pressures driven by unregulated urban expansion in Dhaka. The study highlights the potential of remote sensing and machine learning tools in providing timely, actionable data to support sustainable urban development, land-use regulation, and ecosystem conservation policies.
2608.12001.paper_summary_zh: 快速城市化在孟加拉國達卡區引發了土地利用和環境條件的重大變化，這需要系統性的監測以便進行明智的城市規劃和生態可持續性。這項研究利用遙感數據和機器學習技術，分析2019年至2024年間土地覆蓋和植被動態的時空變化。使用來自Sentinel-2 MSI和Landsat 8的高解析度衛星影像來分類土地覆蓋類型並計算光譜指數，包括歸一化差異植被指數（NDVI）、歸一化差異建成區指數（NDBI）和歸一化差異水體指數（NDWI）。採用監督式機器學習方法，結合決策樹、K-最近鄰（KNN）和隨機森林分類器，使用Google Earth Engine中的標記地理空間訓練點。使用混淆矩陣和卡帕統計進行準確性評估。結果顯示，在五年期間，城市建成區增加了59.5%，而植被（-8.46%）和水體（-7.77%）顯著下降。從植被和水域轉變為城市基礎設施被確定為主要趨勢。在各模型中，隨機森林顯示出最高的分類準確性。這些發現突顯了達卡不受管制的城市擴張所帶來的日益嚴重的環境壓力。該研究強調了遙感和機器學習工具在提供及時、可行數據以支持可持續城市發展、土地使用規範和生態系統保護政策方面的潛力。
